Hi Priya,

I apologise for the delay to order HC-4417. The courier lost a day at the depot, and that is ours to fix.

Your new delivery date is Thursday 5 March. You can follow the parcel here: https://track.harbourcycles.example/HC-4417

To make up for the wait, I have added a $20 credit to your account. It applies to your next order.

Kind regards,
Tom, Harbour Cycles
